HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Action of the incorporator and first written consent of the board of Harbor Labs,
Inc., June 3, 2011
The incorporator elects Jane Doe and Richard Roe as the directors and resigns.
Officers. Jane Doe is Chief Executive Officer and Treasurer. Richard Roe is Chief
Technology Officer. Nina Note is Secretary.
Stock. The board approves the sale of 613,240 shares of common stock to each of Jane
Doe and Richard Roe at $0.0125 per share under the Stock Agreement.
Assignments. As a condition of that sale, each founder must sign a technology
assignment and a confidential information and invention assignment agreement.
Elections. The officers are to remind each founder that any Section 83(b) election
is the founder's own to make and to mail on time.
Bylaws. The bylaws are to be adopted at the board meeting on June 9, 2011.
